capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Polestar US spec page: 82 kWh capacity (gross/usable not split) at 400 V.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: EV Database (European MY24 Polestar 2, same 82 kWh pack): 79.0 kWh usable. Wikipedia: 79 usable / 82 gross for single 2024-25 and dual 2025.

chemistry.notes: Wikipedia: NMC for all Polestar 2 packs (EV Database also NMC).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Polestar US spec page: 400 V lithium-ion, 82 kWh.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Polestar 2 manual (US, 2024): "When charging stations have been added in Google Maps, the battery will be preconditioned to reduce charging time." No manual control mentioned. The manual describes only the navigation trigger but does not state there is no manual control (the 2023 manual refers to "selecting preconditioning"), so the closest enum is used.

dc_max_kw.notes: InsideEVs (Polestar US 2024): Single Motor 82 kWh, about 28 min 10-80% at up to 205 kW.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: 11 kW per the US 2023 Polestar 2 manual and the Polestar US spec page for the 82 kWh cars; same onboard charger.
